review.summary: All tested candidates for the Phoenix model fail to meet the required empirical baseline at every fixed-24-month maturity anchor and do not satisfy the ECE gates. Therefore, none can be promoted to production.
top_technical_reasons: All candidates failed to beat the fixed-24m baseline on Brier and log-loss at all four anchors.
None of the candidates achieved an ECE <= 0.05, which is a prerequisite for promotion.
The current evidence indicates that the model is still in the research phase and requires further data expansion and improvements.
review.candidate_safety: High risk due to failure to meet baseline performance metrics.
